entries.name: Waved rule above a fine straight rule
entries.source_phase: successive downward troughs in upper wave

alignment.method: Robust grayscale centroid fit to lower straight rule

recipe.notes: Three consecutive observed periods from Document Division rule No.20, printed66/archive137. Fourfold bilinear sampling of the retained context supports subpixel fitting without adding source detail. Local paper normalization radius48 sample pixels, threshold210, tones185/210/235. One measured rigid rotation 0.059723713 degrees; uniform source proportions and native ink variation retained. Period boundaries are measured interior repeat sections, not invented isolated terminals. No reconstructed waveform or forced seamless join.

entries.identity_reason: Two-line construction, with a broad shallow wave above a separate straight hairline. Existing fine waves lack the lower straight rule; Boston Floriated4–6 have deep pointed scallops and variable stroke weight.
entries.quality_todo: Seek sharper matching complete impressions and compare repeat-end phase. The three-period source strip preserves native edge and ink variation; joins are not geometrically perfected.

entries.name: Scalloped band above a fine waved rule
entries.source_phase: successive upward crests in lower fine wave

alignment.method: Robust subpixel half-depth fit to straight lower edge of upper scalloped band

recipe.notes: Three consecutive observed periods from Document Division rule No.21, printed66/archive137. Fourfold bilinear sampling of the retained context supports subpixel fitting without adding source detail. Local paper normalization radius48 sample pixels, threshold210, tones185/210/235. One measured rigid rotation 0.022853800 degrees; uniform source proportions and native ink variation retained. Period boundaries are measured interior repeat sections, not invented isolated terminals. No reconstructed waveform or forced seamless join.

entries.identity_reason: Two-line construction, with a filled scalloped upper band and a separate fine waved line. Existing Boston Floriated4–6 lack both this filled band and the paired fine wave. GPO dotted-wave constructions include dots and different outer lines.
entries.quality_todo: Seek sharper matching complete impressions and compare repeat-end phase. The three-period source strip preserves native edge and ink variation; joins are not geometrically perfected.

classification: Two distinct compound printing faces from the five-point metal bodies Nos.20 and21. Body width is context; the revived outlines contain the printing face alone.
comparison: Compared with the existing single fine waved rules, Boston1889 Floriated4–6 and GPO dotted-wave ornaments5/8. Their line count, filled-versus-outline construction, wave contour and component sequence differ.
sampling: Fourfold bilinear sampling of the retained native context, followed by local paper normalization at48 sample pixels. Sampling adds no source detail. The tracing crop selects three complete measured periods.
